title: tithymalus dracunculoides
intro: Tithymalus dracunculoides, commonly known as Sea Rocket or Dragon's Blood, is a plant species in the Euphorbiaceae family. It is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Tithymalus dracunculoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
